brandRule: Machine only on the purple engineering-studio gradient. Exactly one direct-on-surface physical decal reading ÄRT with mechatronics beneath it; no baked title, specifications, ribbon, callout, people or watermark.
sharingRule: A master may be shared only when both the source copy and the externally visible mechanism are genuinely identical.
